title: P15.10 MET-branch hotfix: fold delegated children before TARGET_MET_CANDIDATE review
description: Forensic-confirmed defect on BASE 95c7a71: ObjectiveOperatingLoop.pass() early-returns TARGET_MET_CANDIDATE at the allTargetsMet gate (§6) BEFORE §9 reconcileDelegatedChildren — the only runtime fold seam for IN_PROGRESS delegated children with terminal bound missions. Once KPI is MET the seam is unreachable; a child left IN_PROGRESS with a COMPLETED bound mission never folds at runtime (live evidence: DL_aec59cae in P15.10-D Core E2E V3; KPI MET 04:43:15Z, mission terminal 04:44:25Z — fold window never existed). Fix (minimal, audit-proposed): inside the allTargetsMet+binding branch, re-derive the canonical observation and call the EXISTING reconcileDelegatedChildren BEFORE the deterministic P15.5 review commits. Reconcile only touches INTERVENTION+IN_PROGRESS children whose bound missions are canonically terminal; syncWorkItem re-proves lineage and materializes WCP only when provable (FAILED→BLOCKED, review-required→REVIEW_REQUIRED, forged claims→quarantine/fail-closed). Non-MET flow byte-identical. Suite pair-p15-10d-met-branch-fold.test.ts: 8 tests (T1-T6) — MET-while-RUNNING, terminal-unfolded fold, idempotency, forged-claim fail-closed, FAILED→BLOCKED, non-MET §9 regression + MET-blocks-allocation + step-bound convergence. All green; P15.6/P15.10-D/P15.10-C/P15.5/WFV2-P3 regressions green. No merge/deploy.
